name: Yearn v1 yDAI loose Curve slippage configuration
summary: Yearn's controller selected StrategyDAI3pool for the v1 DAI vault while the strategy's slippage allowance was 1% and the vault's earn() function was permissionless. In each exploit round the attacker imbalanced Curve 3pool, deposited DAI into yDAI, called earn() so the strategy added that DAI near the configured minimum, restored the pool, and withdrew. Eleven transactions repeated the loss-making round trip before Yearn disabled further investment.
notes: The Yearn governance Safe approved StrategyDAI3pool and changed Controller.strategies(DAI) from 0xaa880345a3147a1fc6889080401c791813ed08dc to 0x9c211bfa6dc329c5e757a223fb72f5481d676dc1. This made the strategy's constructor-set slip value of 100 (1%) active for the yDAI vault. No later pre-exploit setStrategy call changed the DAI entry and no setSlip call reached the strategy.

Gross pre-recovery loss to the shares outstanding before the campaign. Immediately before the anchor, at block 11792183, yDAI totalSupply was 31,494,626.844158695810766902 and getPricePerFullShare was 1.110058316613691736 DAI. After the eleventh and final defect-executing transaction, at block 11792351, getPricePerFullShare was 0.758491538466562243 DAI. Their product, (1.110058316613691736 - 0.758491538466562243) * 31,494,626.844158695810766902, is 11,072,464.488546969286678676 DAI. Using only the opening supply excludes attacker-supplied temporary deposits and later users' shares. The attacker's final Curve unwind at block 11792373 raised the onchain share price by 4.067954716 DAI across the opening supply; gross pre-recovery depletion remains the value before that recovery. DAI is valued at par.
